newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia to tender to double oil refinery capacity.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia to tender to double oil refinery capacity.

text.p: Tunisia will relaunch an international tender soon for expanding its sole refinery in Bizerte, Tunisian Industry Minister Slaheddine Bouguerra said on Thursday.
"We are to renew the tender soon," Bouguerra said.
Tunisia plans to double the Societe Tunisienne des Industries de Raffinage (STIR) refinery's capacity to three million tonnes a year from one and a half.
The decision to expand was originally taken in 1988, Bouguerra said, but twice since then STIR granted contracts for suppliers that were subsequently cancelled.
He did not give the reason for this but industry sources said that it was probably because STIR had later subdivided the contracts.
